FN-N262J8J-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 114
Committee: Boards, Agencies and Sponsor: Representative Randall Shedd
Commissions
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 02/07/2025
House Bill 114 as introduced provides for the continuance of the Board of Dental Examiners of
Alabama until October 1, 2027 pursuant to the Alabama Sunset Law. This bill will not
otherwise affect state or local funding.
